cover.coreProposition: Durable agent provenance should separate continuation-stable creation source from derivation lineage: ordinary resume must not silently relabel origin, while fork may establish a new local classification and retain its parent relation; neither label becomes authorization without an independent trust binding.
cover.visualMetaphor: A durable stamped thread continues through several loops while one branch receives a new local seal and retains a fine parent filament
cover.semanticObject: A single continuous archival thread with one clearly derived branch
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one sweeping line, a stable origin seal, one derived branch, muted graphite and teal materials and no explanatory labels
